messages:
jen: FYI, planning to ship schema change to add order_items.sku (nullable). There is a backfill job to populate legacy SKUs, will coordinate cutover window 03:00 UTC.
alex: what's the backfill strategy? single large job will kill replicas.
jen: streaming backfill via backfill-service, per-shard chunking, restartable. Starting small canary for tenant `acme` at 02:00 UTC then ramp. Rate cap default 10 qps/worker.
sam: set a hard rate cap and a holdpoint at cutover. If replication lag > 60s or failed rows > 5% we abort and roll back app migration.
maria: escape hatch: we can pause the backfill workers and flip feature flag. Command to pause: `./scripts/pause_backfill.sh --job=sku_backfill` and set `sku.backfill.enabled=false`.
deploybot: Deploy queued for release/2026.03.20 -> prod. Rollout policy: canary 3% for 15m, then 25% for 15m. Holdpoint scheduled at 03:00:00Z. Lock token: `deploy-3176543210`.
```
deploy start --release=2026.03.20 --canary=3 --holdpoint=2026-03-20T03:00:00Z --lock=deploy-3176543210
```
ops-bot: safepoint set on primary-cluster at 02:50 UTC. Quiesce TTL 20m. Lock owner: deploy-3176543210.
alex: we'll pin the migration version in env: `MIGRATION_LOCK=20260320_sku_v1` so older app versions don't apply it accidentally.
jen: monitoring plan: watch backfill progress dashboard (/dash/backfill/sku), replication lag, and app 5xx rate. Abort criteria: >5% failed rows OR >60s replica lag OR app 5xx increase by >1% absolute.
sam: who takes lease handoff after canary? I'll own the handoff and watch the 03:00 window.
maria: confirm fallback path exists: app will serve sku_fallback when sku is null. I tested it on staging.
jen: quick checklist for cutover:
- start canary backfill 02:00 UTC for tenant acme
- verify zero 5xx and <10s latency change
- at 02:50 set safepoint and ensure no long transactions
- at 03:00 holdpoint: run final small migration, unlock schema add
- ramp backfill to full rate with ratecap=30 qps
- monitor for 1h; if criteria breach -> pause backfill and revert app migration

alex: added escape hatch in runbook: `./scripts/disable_backfill_workers.sh` and feature flag toggle.
jen: will post release notes in #release-notes after canary passes. I'll also annotate deploy with `rollback_on_fail=true`.
deploybot: Canary finished: 3% -> success. No errors in canary tenant.
sam: starting cutover now, will keep this thread updated. I'm oncall until 04:00 UTC. :thumbsup:
maria: pausing non-critical background jobs to reduce DB pressure.
jen: cutover complete, schema applied, backfill ramping to 30 qps. Monitoring looks clean.
alex: ack. leaving a watch for 30m then we close the window.
ops-bot: lock `deploy-3176543210` released at 03:45 UTC.
jen: closing thread once metrics stable. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
